title: An eggless Christmas cake for North Parramatta and Oatlands tables
summary:
Christmas lunch with a vegetarian, Jain or egg-allergic guest at the table? Every cake we make is 100% eggless, so nobody has to ask.

Our Harris Park kitchen bakes custom Christmas cakes for families in North Parramatta, Oatlands and Parramatta. Pick from 15 flavours (Black Forest, Red Velvet and Tiramisu suit a December table) in buttercream, fondant or ganache. A 6-inch serves 6–8 from $39.99; an 8-inch serves 12–14 from $49.99.

Order at least 2 days ahead. Pickup only, from Shop 1, 96–98 Wigram Street, Harris Park.

No eggs. Not in the sponge, not in the buttercream. That is the point. 🎄
